description: Figure: adenosine pocket preserved, phosphate/K+ catalytic site degraded in HSP-110
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
T=pd.read_csv("hsp110_nucleotide_site_distances.csv")
site={"adenosine":"Adenosine / ribose pocket","adenine":"Adenosine / ribose pocket","P-loop":"Adenosine / ribose pocket",
      "phosphate":"Adenosine / ribose pocket"}
cat={"beta/gamma-PO4":"beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site","K+ site":"beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site",
     "Mg2+/K+ ligand":"beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site","DLGGGT / K+ ligand":"beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site",
     "Mg2+/K+ site":"beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site"}
T["group"]=[site.get(r, cat.get(r,"other")) for r in T.role]
sel=T[T.group!="other"].copy()
sel=sel[~sel.Hsc70.isin(["T177","K56"])]
order=sel.sort_values(["group","Hsc70_ATP_A"]).index
sel=sel.loc[order]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,6))
for ax,(metric,lab,ligtxt) in zip(axes,[("ATP_A","Closest side-chain atom to ATP (A)","ATP"),
                                        ("K_A","Closest side-chain atom to the K+ ion (A)","K+")]):
    y=np.arange(len(sel))
    ax.barh(y-0.26,sel["Hsc70_"+metric],height=0.26,color="#1f6f4a",label="Hsc70 (1KAX, Hsp70)")
    ax.barh(y,      sel["Sse1_"+metric], height=0.26,color="#2a7fb8",label="Sse1 (2QXL, yeast Hsp110)")
    ax.barh(y+0.26, sel["Ce_"+metric],   height=0.26,color="#c0392b",label="C. elegans HSP-110 (AlphaFold, superposed)")
    ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.Hsc70}  ({r.CeHSP110})" for r in sel.itertuples()],fontsize=9)
    ax.axvline(3.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=.9)
    ax.text(3.6,len(sel)-0.4,"3.5 A\ncontact limit",fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel(lab); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    for g,c in [("Adenosine / ribose pocket","#2a7fb8"),("beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site","#c0392b")]:
        pass
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
n_ad=(sel.group=="Adenosine / ribose pocket").sum()
for ax in axes:
    ax.axhline(n_ad-0.5,color='grey',lw=1)
axes[0].set_title("Adenosine pocket (top block) is reproduced; beta/gamma-phosphate and K+ site (bottom block) are not\nHsp70 catalytic residues mapped onto the C. elegans HSP-110 AlphaFold model (NBD superposed on Sse1-ATP, 390 CA, RMSD 1.22 A)",
                  fontsize=9.5,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

d_ad=sel[sel.group=="Adenosine / ribose pocket"]
d_ct=sel[sel.group=="beta/gamma-phosphate + K+ site"]
print("Adenosine pocket: mean |Ce - Hsc70| ATP distance shift = %.2f A (n=%d)"%(np.abs(d_ad.Ce_ATP_A-d_ad.Hsc70_ATP_A).mean(),len(d_ad)))
print("Phosphate/K+ site: mean |Ce - Hsc70| ATP distance shift = %.2f A (n=%d)"%(np.abs(d_ct.Ce_ATP_A-d_ct.Hsc70_ATP_A).mean(),len(d_ct)))
print("Phosphate/K+ site: mean |Ce - Hsc70| K+  distance shift = %.2f A"%np.abs(d_ct.Ce_K_A-d_ct.Hsc70_K_A).mean())
from scipy import stats
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(np.abs(d_ad.Ce_ATP_A-d_ad.Hsc70_ATP_A),np.abs(d_ct.Ce_ATP_A-d_ct.Hsc70_ATP_A),alternative='less')
print("Mann-Whitney U (adenosine shift < catalytic shift): U=%.1f p=%.4f"%(u.statistic,u.pvalue))
